content: Large Data Path TP Reception Callbacks Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_CONSTR_00010 If ComIPduLargeData is set to true for a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection RE- CEIVE and ComIPduType TP , the respective <ComUser_ComCbkStartOfRecep- tion> , <ComUser_ComCbkCopyRxData> , <ComUser_ComCbkTpRxIndication> notification callbacks shall be configured too.
